statement: let rad := fun (n : ℕ) => n.primeFactors.prod id; ∀ (a b : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ), 0<a → 0<b → S ⊆ (2*a*b*(a+b)).primeFactors → (∀ p ∈ S, 0≤u p ∧ u p≤1) → S.sum (fun p => u p*Real.log p) ≤ Real.log (rad (a*b*(a+b)))+Real.log 2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 同一包络与局部 Szpiro · JA-0056 · 把 Frey 坏处的整层取整代价控制在全局根基内
plain_statement.en: New route · Common hull and local Szpiro · JA-0056 · Bound whole-lattice rounding at Frey bad places by the global radical

brief.zh: 用 S 中的素数互异和每处取整最多一层，再将素数 2 单列。
brief.en: Use distinct prime support and at most one rounding layer at each place. Account for two separately.
